lines.text: Two years after the flood, Shem fathers Arphaxad, and the line continues until Terah fathers Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
Haran, the father of Lot, dies in Ur of the Chaldeans while his father Terah is still alive.
Terah takes Abram, Lot, and Sarai toward Canaan, but they settle in Haran, where Terah dies at 175.
The LORD tells Abram to go to a land He will show him, and Abram leaves Haran at seventy-five.
Abram travels to the Oak of Moreh at Shechem, where the LORD promises the land to his brother Nahor.
